messages:
priya: Heads-up — after yesterday's KMS alias rotate we see SCIM provisioning skipping role assignments for ~0.3% of Azure AD tenants. Not all users, looks tenant-scoped. Anyone seen this pattern?

maria: I saw 2 alerts earlier but assumed intermittent. Can you paste a sample provisioning payload + error?

priya: Pasting a redacted sample from the provisioning logs:
```
INFO provisioner: start apply for tenant_id=abc-123 user=alice@example.com
ERROR provisioner: role_map_apply failed: kms:Decrypt failed: jwe_context_mismatch
WARN provisioner: fallback: create user without roles
```

sam: That jwe_context_mismatch screams KMS encryption-context mismatch (maybe tenant id included previously). Did the rotation change the context param?

maria: We rotated the key alias and also started using a new context field in the enveloping step to include `tenant_hash`. Old secrets in the tenant store weren't re-wrapped with the new context.

priya: So some tenants still have role blobs encrypted with the old context -> decrypt fails -> provisioner skips roles and proceeds creating user with default roles.

sam: Quick triage options: 1) rewrap role blobs for affected tenants with new context (bulk job), 2) change provisioner to try decrypt with both contexts for a short window, 3) rollback alias to previous key (if still available).

sec-oncall: Mitigation-first: add a short-term code path to attempt decrypt with previous context before skipping roles. Also create a customer-facing incident if >100 users impacted. How many are we at?

priya: Impact: 47 users across 6 tenants so far. All in EU region. No customer-facing reports yet but they might notice missing privileges.

maria: I'll schedule a bulk rewrap job to re-encrypt role blobs with the new context for those 6 tenants. That should be safe and idempotent. Need write perms to key alias `alias/redwood-provisioner-v2`.

sam: I'll open a PR for provisioner to try both contexts (fast toggle via feature flag). Can we also add more detailed logging with tenant_hash and key_id (redacted) to accelerate audits?

priya: Yes please. Also add metric counters: scim.role_decrypt_failure{reason="context_mismatch"} and scim.role_fallback_assigned.

provision-bot: automation: identified 6 tenants with decrypt failures, queueing rewrap job in batch-provisioner (job-id: bp-20260322-17).

sec-oncall: Action items: (1) @maria run rewrap job for bp-20260322-17 and monitor for failures, (2) @sam submit fix/flag to try previous context in provisioner and add metrics, (3) @priya prepare a short incident memo (internal) and a low-severity customer note template in case any tenant asks.

maria: Kicking off rewrap now. Will report back here when finished.

sam: Drafting PR, will link when ready.

priya: Thanks team. If rewrap succeeds we'll consider this resolved and plan a postmortem on the rotation checklist (add rewrap step and backwards-compat flagging).

maria: Rewrap job completed: 47 users rewrapped, 0 failures. Confirmed role assignments applied after retry.

provision-bot: automation: bp-20260322-17 completed in 12m12s.

priya: Marking as resolved for now. Creating postmortem ticket and linking remediation checklist. :white_check_mark:

sec-oncall: Good runbook additions: include a short test plan to exercise SCIM with a rewrapped blob pre-rotation. Also note to keep old key accessible for at least 48h by policy.

sam: PR merged and feature-flagged fallback attempt added. Logs and metrics in place.

priya: Closing thread after postmortem is attached. Thanks all.
